issues.claim: Karr Chester T, DDS - 161 Washington Rd, Sayreville
issues.problem: This dentist does not exist as a current business. Dr. Chester T. Karr retired in 2014 and died in December 2015; directories still carry his old listing at 161 Washington Rd using the phone number that now belongs to Sayreville Dental. The entry is a stale record, and it duplicates Sayreville Dental's address.

issues.claim: Dr. Robert Restaino, DDS - 2909 Washington Rd #135, Parlin
issues.problem: Nothing here is a standalone independent practice. 2909 Washington Rd Suite 135 is the Eastern Dental of Old Bridge office, a multi-site chain the mapper excluded elsewhere; Restaino is a dentist at that chain location.
issues.fix: Delete the entry (the chain office itself is already correctly excluded).

issues.claim: Alan Morgenstern, DDS - 960 US Highway 9, Ste 34, Parlin
issues.problem: He is listed as a dentist with Eastern Dental of Old Bridge (2909 Washington Rd, Suite 135, Parlin), and the 960 Route 9 address appears in some directories as South Amboy, NJ 08879 - a different town. Chain-affiliated and town uncertain.
issues.fix: Delete, or re-verify as South Amboy before any use.

issues.claim: Personal Choice Dental - 811 Washington Rd, Suite A, Parlin
issues.problem: The practice's own office page lists a single office at 2107 Route 516, Suite B, Old Bridge NJ 08857 (732-727-1211); it does not list any Parlin location. An 811 Washington Rd Parlin listing in a dental directory is for Dr. Anthony Vitale, DDS (same practice brand on its Facebook link), so the entry is either an out-of-town practice or a moved/stale address.
issues.fix: Delete, or re-verify the Parlin suite with the practice directly before listing.

issues.claim: Lenahan Chiropractic - 837 Upper Main St, listed as Sayreville
issues.problem: Wrong town. 837 Upper Main St resolves to South Amboy NJ 08879 (Fresha, Zillow, cylex listings) and the practice's own site header brands itself 'Chiropractic South Amboy NJ Lenahan Chiropractic', even though the page copy calls itself a Sayreville chiropractor.
issues.fix: Re-file as South Amboy and remove from the Sayreville zone.

issues.problem: The list carries three pet-care entries (NJ Dog Barbers, Spaw and Stay, Sayrebrook Vet) but misses Mel's Pet Parlor at 137 Main St, Sayreville, which has a large review base and a live booking profile.
issues.fix: Add Mel's Pet Parlor (137 Main St, Sayreville, 732-307-2116).

issues.problem: The list states only one independent PT practice remains in the zone, but FlexFit Physical Therapy, LLC at 776 Jernee Mill Rd, Unit 121, Sayreville is a separate independent practice with a map/directory presence and is not listed.
issues.fix: Add FlexFit Physical Therapy (776 Jernee Mill Rd Unit 121, Sayreville, 347-680-2151) or note why it was rejected.

issues.problem: Several entries record phone 'Unknown' even though the number is on the first page of the business's own site or profile (e.g. Parlin Nails Spa 732-525-0070, Spaw and Stay 732-313-7800, Shadow Nails has its own site shadownailsnj.com, Glorious Hair Restoration 732-515-9600). Some entries also leave website blank where an own site exists (Shadow Nails, Parlin Nails Spa).
issues.fix: Backfill phones/web addresses from the cited profiles before triage.

issues.claim: Wise Counsel Services LLC - 61 Main St, Sayreville
issues.problem: Neither the about page nor the therapy page opened shows a Sayreville street address; the address in the entry comes only from a therapist directory and the practice describes itself as offering teletherapy. In-person location unconfirmed.
issues.fix: Keep flagged as telehealth-only unless a street address is confirmed.
